title: Check OpenCode live with a free model, edits allowed in the project only
body: To verify DD on OpenCode: run `deltadictum install --host opencode --project <scratch>` (skills go to .opencode/skills/: OpenCode reads project skills there, and .agents/skills only from the home folder), then `opencode run -m opencode/deepseek-v4.1-flash-free "..." < /dev/null` from the scratch project. The free models need OpenCode 1.18 or later. `opencode run` auto-rejects every permission prompt, so add `"permission": { "edit": "allow" }` to the scratch project's opencode.json rather than passing --auto, which approves everything. `opencode debug skill` lists the skills a project sees.
not_derivable: Found on 2026-10-22 by running OpenCode 1.16.2 and 1.19.3: the free-tier version floor, the skill folders and the auto-rejected edits show only when a session runs.
